_about: Per-Drake-build field binding. Copy to binding.json and fill in on the VM. INPUT/FOCUS: each field maps a LOGICAL name (what Fynn sends) to how the agent plants a caret. On Drake 2025 the grid is a custom canvas with NO focusable OS elements, so the only reliable focus is a physical mouse CLICK — set "click_xy": [x, y] (window-relative pixels, the field's center). If omitted, the agent clicks the center of "ocr_box". field_no/tab_index (keyboard nav) are fallbacks for builds where they work. The agent tries automation_id, then click_xy, then ocr_box-center, then field_no, then tab_index. READ-BACK: Drake exposes no programmatic value, so verification is either OCR of a screen crop ("ocr_box": [x, y, w, h] window-relative pixels — capture with `agent.py shoot`, read the box off the PNG) or the human screenshot floor. TIP: one `shoot` PNG gives you BOTH click_xy (the box's center) and ocr_box (the box's rectangle).
_main_window_min_note: Minimum [width, height] for the window the agent binds to. Drake's Live Chat overlay is a topmost ~84x84 window in the same process; this size floor makes the agent pick the real data-entry frame instead. Confirm with `agent.py probe` / `shoot`, which print the bound window's title + size.
_send_vk_packet_note: How literal characters are injected. false = real virtual-key + scan-code events (what DOS-heritage apps like Drake require). true = pywinauto's default Unicode 'packet' method, which Drake IGNORES (caret sits in the field, nothing types). Leave false for Drake. CONFIRMED working on Drake Tax 2025.
_tesseract_cmd_note: Full path to tesseract.exe for OCR read-back if it's not on PATH, e.g. "C:\\Program Files\\Tesseract-OCR\\tesseract.exe". Install the Tesseract binary (UB-Mannheim Windows build) plus `pip install pytesseract pillow`. Leave null if tesseract is on PATH.
_enter_index_note: enter_index (per field) = the field's position in Drake's Enter-key navigation order from the first field on screen-open, empirically mapped. W-2 confirmed 2026-07-28: employer_ein=0 -> employer_name=1 -> box1_wages=2 -> box2_fed_wh=3. Sequential entry types down this order pressing Enter to advance; ocr_box gives the pixel rectangle to OCR-verify each value.

capabilities._note: read_back_method: how the agent reads a box back. On Drake 2025 ALL programmatic reads are dead — UIA (0 values), win32 (0 inner fields), clipboard (copy returns nothing + breaks focus). Options: 'ocr' (screenshot a per-field ocr_box crop and OCR it — approximate, needs pytesseract + Tesseract + calibrated ocr_box; set can_read_field_values=true and expect confidence<1.0), 'screenshot' (no automated value — a human verifies the capture; the honest floor), or 'none' (no verification — Fynn's honesty gate keeps live OFF). 'uia'/'clipboard' are kept for other software / a future build.

navigation._note: Key chords in pywinauto send_keys() syntax. IMPORTANT: the CLIPBOARD chords Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C are TOXIC on Drake's canvas — they break field focus and pop the 'fields must contain data' modal (empirically confirmed), so field_clear is Ctrl-free. This does NOT apply to Ctrl+N (headsdown_toggle): Ctrl+N is Drake's OWN documented heads-down mode hotkey, the coordinate-free way to address a field by its number. Calibrate against your build.
navigation._headsdown_note: headsdown_toggle = the chord that toggles heads-down data entry (Drake shows a NUMBER on every field; type the number to jump the caret there — no pixel click). Ctrl+N ('^n') per Drake KB 12130. If a field's binding sets a numeric field_no while ALREADY in heads-down mode, set this to '' so the per-field focus() path doesn't flip the mode off. The `agent.py headsdown` command falls back to '^n' regardless.
navigation._headsdown_popup_note: The heads-down prompt is a REAL dialog window ('Drake 2025 - Heads Down Data Entry') with a normal focusable Edit — unlike the canvas. The driver connects to it via a second win32 pywinauto backend, focuses the Edit, reads the typed field number back (WM_GETTEXT) BEFORE pressing Enter, and HALTs on any unexpected dialog. Confirm the popup title + edit class with `agent.py probe-popup`.
navigation._headsdown_model_note: CONFIRMED on Drake 2025: PERSISTENT command bar — the popup stays up and alternates number -> value -> number, with the value typed INTO the popup. PER-JUMP (popup closes, value on the canvas) is still supported and still auto-detected per jump, so a build or tax-year difference cannot mis-route a value.
navigation._headsdown_autoadvance_note: CONFIRMED Drake 2025: committing field 4 (employer EIN) fires Drake's employer lookup + auto-fill, auto-advances the caret to Box 1 (field 23), and SWALLOWS the next Ctrl+N — which is what made field numbers cascade into the wrong boxes ('5' into Box 1, every value one box further down). _ensure_popup_open now retries the toggle with a settle, re-checking presence before each fire so it can never toggle the mode back off. No per-field special case needed; any other auto-advancing field recovers the same way.
navigation._headsdown_read_channels_note: CONFIRMED Drake 2025: the heads-down popup owns NO child windows (EnumChildWindows returns []) — Drake paints the input box onto the dialog, exactly as it does the data-entry grid. So the popup ITSELF is the keyboard target, and there is no Edit to WM_GETTEXT. These are the channels tried, in order, to read what the popup is showing: 'uia' (accessibility tree — free, exact when Drake exposes anything) then 'ocr' (screenshot the popup + Tesseract — approximate, but the only read a painted box allows). Every safety gate depends on reading the box back BEFORE the irreversible Enter, so with no working channel the run HALTS instead of typing blind. `agent.py probe-popup` reports which channels work on your build.
navigation._auto_dismiss_note: Dialogs a run may answer BY ITSELF, each by clicking a button identified BY NAME — never by pressing Enter on whichever button is the default, because one of the answers to this particular warning LEAVES the data-entry screen and every field number after that would address something else. Matched against the dialog's text, not its title ('Drake 2025 - Data Entry' captions several different dialogs). Anything not listed here still HALTs for a human. Set to [] to make every dialog halt. If this build names the buttons differently, change 'button' — the driver refuses to guess.

auto_dismiss.match: must contain data if you are planning to e-?file
auto_dismiss.why: Drake's e-file completeness warning — OK stays on this screen to finish keying it.

navigation._headsdown_popup_edit_class_note: A PREFERENCE, not a requirement. The driver enumerates the popup's children with ctypes and picks the typing box by shape (any class containing edit/textbox/memo — 'Edit', Delphi's 'TEdit', .NET's 'WindowsForms10.EDIT.app.0.x'), preferring this exact class when it is present and never choosing a Static label. Asking pywinauto for class_name='Edit' is EXACT string equality and found nothing on the live build, which halted every run on its first field with 'popup edit not ready / no handle: timed out'. Set this to the class `probe-popup` reports under edit_class_name to skip the shape search.
navigation._headsdown_checkbox_note: What is typed into a Box 13 checkbox field (46/47/48) when the extracted value is true. 'X' is Drake's classic token; '1' also works on some builds. FALSE is never entered — the agent skips it rather than risk clearing a human's tick. UNCONFIRMED on this build: if Drake rejects the token the run HALTs instead of mis-entering.
navigation._headsdown_prompt_note: The popup's NUMBER prompt reads 'To begin, enter desired field number and press enter.' The driver does NOT hardcode that: it baselines whatever the popup says before Enter and requires the text to CHANGE (Drake took the number) and then to come BACK (Drake took the value). This regex is used only to recognise an INHERITED popup — one left open by probe-popup or a halted run — as safe to type a number into. A popup armed for a VALUE that we did not open makes the run HALT rather than commit the number as a value.

fields._field_no_note: field_no = Drake's HEADS-DOWN field number (Ctrl+N reveals them; type number+Enter to jump). Verified against a screenshot of the live Drake 2025 W-2 screen 2026-08-02. w2_map.W2_FIELD_MAP is the AUTHORITY for entry — this file is documentation; the heads-down path reads numbers from w2_map, not from here. NOT COVERED, enter by hand: employer foreign address (11/12/13) and employee foreign address (20/21/22) are FOREIGN-ONLY boxes the map refuses to bind; box 9 (31) is greyed out; the bottom checkboxes 85/86/87 and anything >=88 are UNCONFIRMED. There is NO employee SSN box on this screen — it comes from screen 1. Dropdowns (1, 9, 18, box12 codes 34/37/40/43, state 57/64/71/78, locality 63/70/77/84) may need selection handling rather than plain typing. Re-verify every number after a Drake tax-year update: they shift.
